# Gjall

Internal ID: Gjall | Faction: Mistlands | Main biome: Mistlands | Tameable: No | Drops: Bilebag | Gjall trophy | Abilities: Spit (6s), Egg (50s, 3 Ticks ), Shake (10s) | Trophy: Gjall trophy | Neutral to (x1): Blunt, ,, Slash, ,, Fire, ,, Frost, ,, Lightning, ,, Poison | Resistant to (x0.5): Fire | Immune to (x0): Spirit, ,, Chop, ,, Pickaxe | Location: Eggs | Very weak to (x2): Pierce

# Introduction

Gjall are massive flying, aggressive creatures found in the Mistlands. If there is one nearby, you will be alerted by a unique sound: a cross between a plane and an airhorn. Additionally, the mist in the immediate area around a Gjall will have a fiery orange hue.

## Drops

• Item: Bilebag | 0 Star: 1 | 1 Star: 1 | 2 Star: 1

• Item: Gjall trophy | 0 Star: 30% | 1 Star: 30% | 2 Star: 30%

## Spawning

• Type: Middle of the Mistlands during the daytime | Limit: 1 | Frequency: Very rare | Stars: No

• Type: Middle of the Mistlands during the nighttime, despawn at dawn | Limit: 1 | Frequency: Very rare | Stars: Yes

• Type: During "What's up, Gjall!?" event before defeating The Queen | Limit: 1 | Frequency: Very common | Stars: No

### Spit

Inhales a little before spitting out two balls of fire which inflict the Burning status (50 Blunt and 80 Fire damage). Each fireball travels at 15 meters per second for up to 10 seconds before despawning and has a spread of 10–20 degrees. This attack can be used every 6 seconds when within 6–30 meters of a player — standing on top of the Gjall disables this attack.

### Egg

Leans back and drops three eggs, which hatch into Ticks when hitting the ground. This ability can be used every 50 seconds when within 10–20 meters of a player — standing on top of the Gjall disables this ability.

### Shake

Sways from side to side, hitting in a 3.41-meter radius sphere around themselves three times (20 Blunt damage each hit). Gjalls can do this every 10 seconds when within 6 meters of a player. The attack cannot be blocked or dodged.

## Notes

• Gjall are very dangerous creatures but can easily be outrun. Therefore, fleeing is an option if you have sufficient stamina.
• Pierce resistance is useful against the ticks if they become a problem

## Trivia

• In Norse mythology, the Gjallarhorn is blown by Heimdallr to signal the commencement of Ragnarok.
• There are different ways to pronounce Gjall: In Old Norse, it would be pronounced /ˈɡjɑlː/ g'yall with hard g as in get and long l at the end. This pronunciation would be the closest to the Viking lore. In modern Norwegian, it is pronounced /jɑl/ yal, like y'all. Many players prefer this pronunciation and it also matches the puns in Gjall events better. In modern Swedish, it is pronounced /jalː/ yahll with a as in the first half of cow and long l at the end. In modern Danish, it is pronounced /ˈkjæl/ k'yael with k as in scar and ae in bat. In modern Icelandic, it is pronounced /catl/ tyahtl with ty as in stew.
• The name "Gjall" is probably inspired by the name of the mythological river Gjöll, meaning "noisy" "loud" or "scream".
• The sound made by the Gjall is most likely a reference to the sound made by the tripods in War of the Worlds. It may also take inspiration from the World War 2-era German dive bomber Junkers JU-87 "Stuka" which was known for its loud siren as it approached high speeds on a bombing run.
• The process behind the unique sounds made by Gjall was broken down in the video What's up gjall? by Iron Gate.
